digest.component_or_area: transition request value object / close-reason and force plumbing
propositions: Close-reason and force plumbing is computed independently across three surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) with inconsistent logic: CLI at transition.py:584, library at _lib_writes.py:318, MCP at _mcp_writes.py:224-232 lacks reason parameter entirely.
CLI refuses inadmissible reasons (exit 1) while library silently discards them (returns 0), creating pinned asymmetric behaviour that cannot be merged without breaking test suites.

The '(no reason given)' placeholder string literal appears in five code production sites across three files and must be centralized as a single named constant with a guarded single-assignment invariant.

A bare --force close must remain accepted despite reason normalization timing and force-disqualifies-but-satisfies-requirement duality between close_reason, force_note, and reason_refusal() accessors.
Empty reasons must never flow to close_disposition.verdict, as normalizing to placeholder would incorrectly convert UNJUSTIFIED dispositions to SIGNED ones.
MCP transition_ticket must expose reason parameter by constructing TransitionRequest, flipping strict-xfail row in write_parity_contract from fail to pass.
